SUMMARY & CAREER OBJECTIVE
Finance professional with 1.10 years of experience in OTC Derivatives, specializing in settlements IRP, FX and CD. Experienced in end-to-end trade lifecycle management and collaborating with global stakeholders while ensuring operational accuracy, risk control, and compliance. Seeking to contribute my analytical and operational expertise in a growth-oriented organization.
raw_sections.experience:
RELEVANT EXPERIENCE
eClerx
September 2024 - July 2026
Financial Analyst (Full-time)
Managed the end-to-end trade lifecycle and settlement processing for OTC derivatives, including IRP, FX, and CD. Processed 100–200+ trades daily while ensuring operational accuracy, timely execution, and adherence to settlement deadlines. Maintain positive and professional relationships with External Clients & Client Service (Customer Relation) Management. Ensure completion of BAU tasks, activities and operational deliverables within daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly deadlines Collaborated with Front office, middle office, legal and counterparties to resolve the trade economic and non-economic discrepancies, minimize trade breaks and ensure timely settlement. Created SOPs and structed training material for onboarding, reducing training time and improving domain knowledge transfer. Maintained dashboards to track settlement status, pending items, and key operational metrics. Prepared and maintained daily/monthly reports ensuring accuracy and timely delivery to stakeholders. Managed large datasets, ensuring data integrity, completeness, and compliance with internal guidelines. Automated and optimized reporting processes, improving efficiency and reducing manual errors. Assisted in UAT testing for system enhancements and new process implementations related to derivatives processing. Actively participated in knowledge sharing and cross-training within the team to improve overall productivity. Proactively identified potential settlement risks around cut-off breaches and implemented corrective actions.

Portfolio Management Services

Designed and managed a mock investment portfolio across equity instruments. Performed fundamental and technical analysis to select securities based on risk-return objectives. Monitored portfolio performance using key financial ratios and market benchmarks.
